Well, I have started to create some images with AI, I know that the quality isn't good, but with a shitty PC, it takes time to retry just to make a little better.

I have created a software to make easier to create some images, what you are seeing here are one of tests.

The general idea is that you can choose a character, a style, a scene, and the software does the rest for you, in the next few days I will be uploading some of my tests here
